Render with the ragg/AGG backend so fonts resolve. # Fail fast if Roboto Condensed isn't visible to R (restart R after installing). if (!any(grepl("Roboto Condensed", systemfonts::system_fonts()$family, fixed = TRUE))) { stop("Roboto Condensed not found. Restart R after installing, then re-run.") } calendar_start <- as.Date("2025-01-01") calendar_end <- as.Date("2026-12-31") hire_date <- as.Date("2024-12-11") season_opener_2026 <- as.Date("2026-08-29") unc_off_field_events <- tibble::tribble( ~date, ~event, as.Date("2025-02-28"), "Hard Knocks announced", as.Date("2025-03-03"), "Hard Knocks falls through; staff finalized", as.Date("2025-04-15"), "Hudson [needs label]", as.Date("2025-04-27"), "CBS Sunday Morning interview", as.Date("2025-05-09"), "Hudson barred from facility", as.Date("2025-07-18"), "Hulu docuseries announced", as.Date("2025-10-07"), "Suspension; Hulu docuseries cancelled", as.Date("2025-10-16"), "Report: Lombardi in Saudi Arabia", as.Date("2026-01-09"), "Petrino hired", as.Date("2026-07-27"), "Lombardi placed on leave", as.Date("2026-08-06"), "Steve Belichick placed on leave" ) |> dplyr::filter(date >= calendar_start, date <= calendar_end) |> dplyr::arrange(date) # raw_games <- dplyr::bind_rows(get_games(2025), get_games(2026)) |> # dplyr::filter(homeTeam == "North Carolina" | awayTeam == "North Carolina") # Conference flag is optional; without it the header reports overall record only. # if (!"conferenceGame" %in% names(raw_games)) { # raw_games$conferenceGame <- NA # } # unc_game_days <- raw_games |> # dplyr::transmute( # date = as.Date(startDate, tz = "America/New_York"), # opponent = dplyr::if_else(homeTeam == "North Carolina", awayTeam, homeTeam), # is_conference_game = conferenceGame, # north_carolina_points = dplyr::if_else( # homeTeam == "North Carolina", homePoints, awayPoints # ), # opponent_points = dplyr::if_else( # homeTeam == "North Carolina", awayPoints, homePoints # ), # game_status = dplyr::case_when( # is.na(north_carolina_points) ~ "Upcoming game", # north_carolina_points > opponent_points ~ "Win", # TRUE ~ "Loss" # ) # ) |> # dplyr::filter(date >= calendar_start, date <= calendar_end) unc_game_days <- readr::read_csv("unc_game_days.csv") days_since_hire <- as.numeric(season_opener_2026 - hire_date) games_before_opener <- sum(unc_game_days$date < season_opener_2026) season_summary <- unc_game_days |> dplyr::mutate(season = as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))) |> dplyr::summarise( wins = sum(game_status == "Win"), losses = sum(game_status == "Loss"), upcoming = sum(game_status == "Upcoming game"), conf_wins = sum(game_status == "Win" & is_conference_game %in% TRUE), conf_losses = sum(game_status == "Loss" & is_conference_game %in% TRUE), has_conf_flag = any(!is.na(is_conference_game)), opener = min(date), games_first_35 = sum(date <= min(date) + 35), .by = season ) |> dplyr::mutate( record_text = dplyr::case_when( upcoming > 0 & wins + losses == 0 ~ paste0( "??–?? (only ", games_first_35, " games in the first 35 days)" ), upcoming > 0 ~ paste0( wins, "–", losses, " so far (only ", games_first_35, " games in the first 35 days)" ), has_conf_flag ~ paste0( wins, "–", losses, " overall (", conf_wins, "–", conf_losses, " ACC)" ), TRUE ~ paste0(wins, "–", losses, " overall") ) ) block_width <- 8.8 # 7 day columns + gutter block_height <- 8.6 # 6 week rows + gutter year_gap <- 3.0 calendar_grid <- tibble::tibble( date = seq(calendar_start, calendar_end, by = "day") ) |> dplyr::mutate( year = as.integer(format(date, "%Y")), month_index = as.integer(format(date, "%m")), month_label = format(date, "%B"), mday = as.integer(format(date, "%d")), weekday_index = (as.POSIXlt(date)$wday + 6L) %% 7L + 1L # Mon = 1 ) |> dplyr::mutate( first_weekday = weekday_index[mday == 1L], .by = c(year, month_index) ) |> dplyr::mutate( week_of_month = (mday + first_weekday - 2L) %/% 7L + 1L, block_row = (month_index - 1L) %/% 3L + 1L, block_col = (month_index - 1L) %% 3L + 1L, year_offset = year - min(year), x_left = (year_offset * 3L + block_col - 1L) * block_width + year_offset * year_gap, x = x_left + weekday_index, y = (block_row - 1L) * block_height + week_of_month ) |> dplyr::left_join(unc_game_days, by = dplyr::join_by(date)) |> dplyr::left_join(unc_off_field_events, by = dplyr::join_by(date)) |> dplyr::mutate( game_status = dplyr::coalesce(game_status, "No game"), day_text_color = dplyr::if_else(game_status == "Loss", "light", "dark"), is_opener = date == season_opener_2026 ) month_blocks <- calendar_grid |> dplyr::distinct(year, month_index, month_label, block_row, x_left) |> dplyr::mutate( y_title = (block_row - 1L) * block_height - 1.7, y_header = (block_row - 1L) * block_height - 0.6 ) weekday_headers <- tidyr::expand_grid( month_blocks |> dplyr::select(x_left, y_header), tibble::tibble( weekday_index = 1:7, weekday_label = c("Mo", "Tu", "We", "Th", "Fr", "Sa", "Su") ) ) |> dplyr::mutate(x = x_left + weekday_index) year_headers <- calendar_grid |> dplyr::summarise(x = min(x_left) + 1, .by = year) |> dplyr::left_join(season_summary, by = dplyr::join_by(year == season)) |> dplyr::mutate( y = -4.4, label = paste0( "", year, "", " | ", "", record_text, "" ) ) y_top <- -6.2 y_bottom <- max(calendar_grid$y) + 1.2 unc_calendar_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(calendar_grid, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y)) + ggplot2::geom_tile( ggplot2::aes(fill = game_status), width = 0.92, height = 0.92, color = "#FFFCF0", linewidth = 0.3 ) + ggplot2::geom_tile( data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, !is.na(event)), ggplot2::aes(color = "Off-field event"), width = 0.92, height = 0.92, fill = NA, linewidth = 0.9 ) + ggplot2::geom_tile( data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, is_opener), ggplot2::aes(color = "2026 season opener"), width = 1.06, height = 1.06, fill = NA, linewidth = 1.4 ) + ggplot2::geom_text( data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, day_text_color == "dark"), ggplot2::aes(label = mday), family = "Roboto Condensed", size = 2.1, color = "#100F0F" ) + ggplot2::geom_text( data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, day_text_color == "light"), ggplot2::aes(label = mday), family = "Roboto Condensed", size = 2.1, color = "#FFFCF0" ) + ggplot2::geom_text( data = month_blocks, ggplot2::aes(x = x_left + 1, y = y_title, label = month_label), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, family = "Roboto Condensed", fontface = "bold", size = 3.2, color = "#100F0F" ) + ggplot2::geom_text( data = weekday_headers, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y_header, label = weekday_label), inherit.aes = FALSE, family = "Roboto Condensed", size = 2.1, color = "#878580" ) + ggtext::geom_richtext( data = year_headers, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, family = "Roboto Condensed", fill = NA, label.color = NA, label.padding = grid::unit(0, "lines") ) + ggplot2::scale_fill_manual( values = c( "No game" = "#E6E4D9", "Win" = "#56A0D3", "Loss" = "#1F5A7A", "Upcoming game" = "#C6DEEE" ), breaks = c("Win", "Loss", "Upcoming game"), name = NULL ) + ggplot2::scale_color_manual( values = c( "Off-field event" = "#AF3029", "2026 season opener" = "#D0A215" ), breaks = c("Off-field event", "2026 season opener"), name = NULL ) + ggplot2::guides( fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 1), color = ggplot2::guide_legend( order = 2, override.aes = list(fill = NA, linewidth = 1.1) ) ) + ggplot2::scale_y_reverse(limits = c(y_bottom, y_top)) + ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = 1)) + ggplot2::coord_fixed(ratio = 1, clip = "off") + ggplot2::labs( title = "The
